clips.title: The story
paras: Menethil Harbor fears its relics will fall to local enemies. The harbor authorities send the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep for safekeeping.

Menethil Harbor links the northern Eastern Kingdoms to the south. The port honors the late King Terenas Menethil II of Lordaeron, but treacherous marshes and enemies surround it. With threats mounting, harbor leaders fear the exposed outpost cannot protect relics from the fallen northern kingdom.

Dragonmaw orcs still infest the Wetlands. The clan has a dark past and a taste for ruthless advantage. Harbor defenders fear the orcs would pillage the Menethil Statuette for conquest, then defile it or turn it to their own ends.

The courier carries the relic straight to Stormwind Keep, bypassing the usual military and bureaucratic channels. There it goes to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the young King Anduin Wrynn. The capital's leaders are trusted to safeguard a piece of Lordaeron's heritage.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.
The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... And I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.
Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, friend. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
